label: searchMovies.orama_search_hybrid
reason: The Orama hybrid search limit increased from 1000 to 1500, likely increasing search work, allocations, and latency; measuring the `search()` call isolates backend/query-time impact from post-processing.
return_value_change: searchMovies may return a larger array (more hits/candidates) because the underlying Orama `limit` increased from 1000 to 1500, increasing downstream processing and potentially response size.

label: searchMovies.postprocess_candidates_and_levenshtein
reason: Increasing search limit increases `vectorResult.hits` length, which linearly (or worse) increases cost of mapping candidates, Levenshtein-based ordering, and Map construction; this span quantifies the CPU overhead introduced by larger candidate sets.
return_value_change: Because post-processing operates over `vectorResult.hits`, a higher hit cap can indirectly increase the number of returned ordered hits and the work done per request, affecting callers that iterate or serialize the results.

label: rate_limiter.error_path_logging
reason: New console.debug added in the middleware error path; logging an Error object can trigger formatting/serialization and I/O, and under sustained rate-limiting this path can become hot and add measurable latency before responding 429.
